Zoe (CSM): Quick flag  MeridianCare dropped ~60% API traffic overnight after their ML lead left. Procurement asked for a vendor TCO snapshot; renewal in ~4w. Need a rapid triage and retention play. :warning:
Cal (CS Ops): On it. First checks: key validity, allowlist, tenant throttles. Any console notes?
Zoe (CSM): Console shows activity stopped ~30h ago. New PM unresponsive to invites. Dedicated seats idle.
Isha (Solutions Eng): Ask them to run this from their infra: `curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $MERIDIAN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health` 
401/403 -> key; 429 -> throttles; 5xx -> edge.
edge-alert: [auto] 2026-01-12T02:13:00Z - edge blip (us-east-1) 02:10-02:18 UTC - ~900 requests.
Cal (CS Ops): Tenant logs show 403s at 02:09 UTC, then retries and a few 429s. Looks like token rejection + retry burst.
Marco (AE): Competitor demo highlighted an "integration adapter" and lower unit price. If this is a config issue we can fix fast. Propose: 1) offer 10-day Dedicated extension 2) 30m triage w/SE 3) send apples-to-apples TCO + ops delta doc.
Isha (Solutions Eng): I'll draft a troubleshooting checklist and a tiny benchmark script (ETA: today EOD).
Cal (CS Ops): Action items: @Isha checklist + script, @Zoe schedule triage Mon AM, @Marco prep TCO note and loop finance. I'll issue a short-lived support token and flag billing to pause auto-invoice if extension approved.
Zoe (CSM): I'll ping the PM + procurement now and escalate to executive sponsor if no reply by EOD. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
